name: badge
title: Badge
author: Hubert Formin <hformin@gmail.com>
description: A mono uppercase state marker in five tones. Use to mark the state of the thing it sits beside.

hairline.antiExampleWhy: Border-only accent, stock palette colour, and not the mono uppercase label the system uses for state.

docs: Ink and wash travel together — never a border-only accent, and never colour alone.
